capitals.name: Andorra
capitals.note: CIA World Factbook lists: Andorra la Vella

governmentType.value: parliamentary democracy (since March 1993) that retains its chiefs of state in the form of a co-principality; the two princes are the President of France and Bishop of Seu d'Urgell, Spain
governmentType.note: The CIA discontinued the World Factbook on 2026-02-04; this is its last data and will not be updated.
